title: To Shing S2
description: Founded in 2017, To Shing is a Minecraft modded city server where architects craft a sprawling fictional city inspired by authentic Hong Kong aesthetics and urban world-building.
body:
# Welcome to To Shing！

**To Shing** — A Minecraft integrated modded city server. 
Since the establishment of the To Shing Community in 2017, it has connected with over 600 Bedrock and Java edition players. The To Shing (S2) Community has flourished through completely free building and a spirit of mutual learning, further supercharged by high-quality video and media productions. To this day, To Shing players remain committed to their core values, dedicated to bringing their city dreams to life, in To Shing.
